meta.summary: Only Humans and Orcs can multiclass, once they reach level 50. Each primary class has a short list of allowed secondary classes, and the race must be allowed to play the secondary. Multiclassing restarts the character at level 1. Skills only the secondary class has arrive five levels later with 95% of the normal cap; shared skills use the better of the two. Secondary-class spells the primary lacks count one circle higher. Spell slots are halved unless both classes are pure casters. Hit points use the better class modifier, combat speed the faster class, damage output the higher class, and to-hit the better class tier. Items usable by either class can be worn. Multiclassed characters cannot specialise, memorise 1.75x slower, and do not get the druid/blighter fast-casting rules.
meta.levels_note: Multiclass builds exist at every level 1-56: a character multiclasses after reaching level 50 and the engine then restarts it at level 1 (specs.room.c:217 -> actwiz.c:5797).

rules.min_level: multiclass.level.req.min = 50 (lib/duris.properties:43); code defaults 41 (actoth.c:117) and 50 (specs.room.c:160); epic requirement 0 (duris.properties:44)
rules.level_after_multiclass: reset to level 1: multiclass_proc calls do_start (src/specs/specs.room.c:217), do_start_impl sets player.level = 1 (src/cmd/actwiz.c:5797)
rules.skills: secondary-only skills at level+5 with cap x0.95; shared skills min(pri, sec+5) level and max cap (src/core/utility.c:5787-5834)
rules.spells: secondary spells the primary lacks count one circle higher; circle-12 secondary spells unreachable (src/classes/memorize.c:279-286)
rules.slots: semi caster (slots (j+1)/2) unless both classes are pure casters (src/classes/memorize.c:125-143, 187-197); no creation class is a partial caster
rules.hit_points: class_hitpoints = max of the two classes (src/magic/affects.c:381-385)
rules.pulse_output: combat pulse = min, totalOutput (damage mod) = max (src/magic/affects.c:1716-1724)
rules.thac0: first matching class tier for either class = the higher factor (src/combat/fight.c:6580-6613)
rules.gear_con_max: max-con gear bonus only when both classes qualify (src/magic/affects.c:396-397)
rules.cast_cycle: druid D/2+6 and blighter halving are not applied to multiclass (src/net/sparser.c:2477, 2518-2519)
rules.items: usable if either class may use the item (src/world/handler.c:6181-6197)
rules.memorisation: x1.75 (src/classes/memorize.c:678-693; lib/duris.properties:2129) - no effect on a pre-memorised duel
